concepts.gloss_en: a rabbi (together) with students — the configuration of master and disciples as a spiritual aspect
a TRUE/authentic rabbi with students — qualified form specifying the genuine master; 'אמתי' is a loaded Breslov qualifier, not an orthographic variant

members.note: The text equates the two ('this is the aspect of rabbi-with-students, i.e. when there is a TRUE rabbi with students'), but the equation holds only within this single Torah (lm2:5) and 'אמתי' adds a substantive qualifier (authentic master). Under-merge preferred; human to decide.

notes: Both forms occur only in lm2:5, where lm2:5 defines רבי עם תלמידים by reference to a רבי אמתי. This is a local clarifying equation, not established identity; 'אמתי' is a meaningful modifier so the forms are kept separate per the under-merge rule. Note: the proof quotes attached to 'רבי עם תלמידים' (about גרים/ישיבה, Bamidbar 24) appear mismatched to the form and were disregarded in judging the referent.
